title: Man. Post. Cap. X: PLAC — I did not argue from non-duration of imputation; you twist my case
pass_a_gloss: Placeus denies the rewrite: he did not conclude that Adam’s disobedience was unimputed until the law because it did not endure until the law. The learned man turns an invincible argument into a silly absurdity he can then brand and refute.
pass_b_english: PLAC. I did not gather that Adam’s disobedience was not imputed until the law because it did not endure until the law.
My argument, which is invincible, the learned man transforms into another, inept and absurd, which he can then easily both traduce and refute.
source_text: PLAC. Non collegi inobedientiam Adami non fuisse imputatam usque ad legem, quia non perduravit usque ad legem. Argumentum meum, quod est invictum, Vir doctus in aliud transmutat ineptum & absurdum, quod possit facile & traducere, & refellere.

choices.choice: Placeus did not argue from non-duration of imputation
